An '''assassin''' of [[House Rist]] murdered [[Gaul Panteer]], the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] and [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A recording of Panteer's [[Death/Legends|death]] was later uncovered, proving that his death was not an accident or of natural causes, happening shortly before House Rist's assassination of his mother, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Silara Panteer]].
